name: A Grim Task
summary: Longbraid the Grim seeks vengeance in the Wetlands after Dun Modr falls. The Dark Iron assault shattered the Thandol Span and took the lives of his brother and many soldiers. Now he wants Balgaras the Foul slain, with the warlock's ear as proof.

sections.title: The Ruins of Dun Modr
sections.body: The northern Wetlands are scarred by fighting between Ironforge Mountaineers and Dark Iron infiltrators. Dun Modr fell during the siege, and the western bridge of the Thandol Span was shattered. Longbraid the Grim lost many loyal soldiers and his brother in the assault. He wants the Dark Iron clan to pay for those deaths.

sections.title: A Cowardly Commander
sections.body: Scouts such as Roggo have found that Balgaras the Foul commands the Dark Iron force occupying Dun Modr. The warlock hides while ordering his soldiers to carry out his dark designs. Longbraid hopes Balgaras's death will break the force's resolve and let Ironforge's survivors secure the passage north.

faq.answer: Balgaras the Foul is a Dark Iron warlock commanding the force occupying Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands. Longbraid the Grim calls him a coward who avoids direct combat while sending Dark Iron troops to hold the region.

Longbraid the Grim is a dwarf commander encamped outside Dun Modr's ruins. Dark Iron forces seized the settlement and destroyed the Thandol Span's western crossing, killing his brother and many of his soldiers.

faq.q: Why does Longbraid want Balgaras's ear?
faq.answer: Longbraid wants Balgaras's ear as proof of the warlock's death. Balgaras is elusive and often hides from open battle.

faq.q: What happened to the Thandol Span?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves destroyed the western bridge of the Thandol Span during their surprise attack on Dun Modr. The crossing between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands is cut off.
Balgaras hides among the captured fortifications and ruins around Dun Modr, behind his soldiers rather than out in the marshlands.

faq.q: What happens after Balgaras is slain?
faq.answer: Longbraid believes Balgaras's death will make the remaining Dark Iron troops easier to defeat before another commander arrives to reinforce them.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, the Dark Iron clan's violence at Dun Modr is a personal affront and a fresh wound in the clans' long civil strife.
As an Alliance traveler, you know the Thandol Span is the main land route between Khaz Modan and Lordaeron. Removing the Dark Iron saboteurs matters to the whole Alliance.
As a warlock, you know the dangerous ends to which the Dark Irons turn their craft: Balgaras the Foul uses fel magic to direct the slaughter of Dun Modr's defenders.
